zh.title: 歐洲空管罷工第三天 週末逾 1,200 航班取消
zh.summary: 法義空管工會罷工持續，Eurocontrol 統計平均空域延誤 41 分鐘，巴黎兩大機場削減 30% 班表。
body: 法國與義大利空管工會罷工進入第三天，Eurocontrol 統計本週末歐洲已取消逾1,200航班，另有平均41分鐘的空域流量延誤。
罷工主因為人力編制與排班改革爭議。法國民航總局已要求各航空公司削減巴黎戴高樂與奧利機場30%班表。
多家航空公司開放受影響旅客免費改期。Eurocontrol 預估若協商未果，下週影響將擴及跨大西洋航線的歐洲銜接段。

en.title: European ATC strike hits day three; 1,200+ weekend cancellations
en.summary: Eurocontrol logs 41-minute average flow delays; Paris airports cut 30% of schedules.
body: Strikes by French and Italian ATC unions entered a third day, with more than 1,200 weekend cancellations across Europe and average flow delays of 41 minutes, per Eurocontrol.

The dispute centres on staffing and rostering reform. France's DGAC ordered 30% schedule cuts at Paris CDG and Orly; carriers are offering free rebooking. Eurocontrol warns transatlantic connections could be affected next week if talks fail.

zh.title: A320neo 高空熄火事件 EASA 令 15 日內檢查特定批次燃油泵
zh.summary: 兩起引擎短暫熄火事件後，EASA 發布緊急適航指令，全球約 340 架受影響。
body: EASA 發布緊急適航指令（AD），要求營運人於15個飛行日內檢查特定批次 A320neo 系列的燃油泵，起因於近期兩起高空引擎短暫熄火事件。
受影響批次涉及全球約340架飛機。指令要求核對泵體序號並更換疑慮批件，多數檢查可於過夜停場完成。
空中巴士表示已與供應商確認製程偏差根因，新批件供應無虞；FAA 預計將跟進發布對等指令。

en.title: A320neo fuel-pump AD: EASA orders checks within 15 flight days
en.summary: Two high-altitude flameout events prompt an emergency directive covering about 340 aircraft.
body: EASA issued an emergency airworthiness directive requiring operators to inspect fuel pumps from specific A320neo-family batches within 15 flight days, after two brief high-altitude flameout events.

About 340 aircraft are affected worldwide. Most checks fit an overnight stop; Airbus says the root cause is a confirmed supplier process deviation and replacement parts are available. The FAA is expected to mirror the directive.
